title: Vendor API locked without the key
when: GET /api/vendor/tenants with no auth, wrong key; then right key. Also start with VENDOR_API_KEY unset

title: Create restaurant from the admin panel sends a welcome link
when: Admin panel (admin/ server pointed at the test server) → + New restaurant: 'Multan Tikka', owner 'Bilal', '03003333333', fee 5000
then: Success card shows welcome link + Copy message (contains link and PIN); tenant listed with status trial, trial_ends +14 days; server log shows VENDOR-WA (not connected) line with the link; vendor_audit row with who

title: Welcome link sets the password and signs in
when: Open the welcome link in a fresh browser; set password 'multan-pass-1' (+confirm)
then: Lands in the app as Multan Tikka admin without an OTP step on this device; link reused → 'expired or used' message; old password-less login impossible

title: Forgot password via WhatsApp link
when: Sign-in → Forgot password → phone 03003333333; also an unknown phone; open the reset link, set new password; sign in with old and new
then: Same message for both phones; reset link in log only for the real one; old password 401, new works; reset link single-use and expires after 1 h (test by editing expires_at)

title: OTP goes through the vendor WhatsApp sender
when: Sign in on a new device_id with WhatsApp not linked
then: Log line 'VENDOR-WA (not connected) to 03…: Your HazelPOS sign-in code is …'; that code works

title: Owner adds, edits and removes staff
when: Settings → Staff & PINs: add cashier 'Sana' PIN 4826; add another with the same PIN; edit Sana to kitchen; try removing own login; remove Sana
then: Sana appears on the till lock screen and can log in on a till; duplicate PIN → 'Someone here already uses that PIN'; own/last admin removal refused; after removal Sana's sessions stop working (401)

title: Same PIN allowed in a different restaurant
when: Add a staff with PIN 4826 in another restaurant
then: Allowed; each logs in only on their own restaurant's till

title: Invoices generate, notify and mark paid
then: One invoice per tenant with fee>0, second call creates none; WhatsApp log line per tenant; Mark paid in admin panel records method/ref/who

title: Trial → past_due → suspended → active
when: Set trial_ends in the past; run lifecycle; generate invoice with due_date 8 days ago; run lifecycle; mark paid
then: past_due (POS owner banner visible); then suspended (new order 402); after paid → active, ordering works; each change audited

title: Admin panel pages work and old pages are gone
when: Visit Restaurants, detail, Unpaid, Settings → HazelPOS WhatsApp, Activity
then: All load with no console errors; WhatsApp page shows a QR image after 'Link number' (QR may expire; just an with data:image/png); nav has no installer/activation/setup/updates/usage; buttons ≥44px

title: Vendor actions don't leak tenant data into each other
when: Create a restaurant while another is active and has orders
then: New restaurant has seed menu only, no other restaurant's orders/staff; slice A api suite still passes

title: Browser print fallback prints only the bill
when: Restaurant without a printer helper: receipt Print and delivery 'Print bill'; stub window.print and capture what is visible under print media
then: Only the bill is visible in print media (restaurant name, order no, items, totals; delivery: customer, phone, address); app chrome hidden; no failing requests
